    # Avoid division by zero or log(0)
    new_utilization = np.where(bins > 0, new_utilization, 0)
    # Use log(1 + utilization gain) as proxy for priority
    priorities = np.where(can_fit, np.log1p(new_utilization), 0)
    return priorities
